name: PRXVTStaking reward accounting not settled on transfer
summary: PRXVTStaking issued transferable stPRXVT receipts but never settled or reset reward accounting on transfer, so moving the staked balance through a series of fresh CREATE2 addresses let each one report the full accumulated earned() and call claimReward() again.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: PRXVTStaking (verified source) created 2025-12-31 by 0xa116959ffe4f64b82e294ef2209b34423c078e9f (not the attacker 0x7407f9bd...), no Upgraded events - the exploited code was under 8 hours old. The PoC loop deploys Attack2 helpers with CREATE2, transfers stPRXVT to each and calls claimReward(). Loss 32.8 ETH; DefiLlama records $97,000 (Staking Logic Flaw, Base).
